claims.claim: The effective owned commander closure covers all eight required Revolution Overdrive Mods with exact source/asset hashes and no effective missing files.
All 31 owned RO maps remain source-complete and the representative traynor01 MPQ is readable.

The approved launcher stages the complete closure, reaches CreateGame=init_game and JoinGame=in_game, advances observations to loop 48, accepts ActionChat(Iron), and has a clean same-window ScriptError scan.

Native AI ally behavior remains blocked after strict P1 participant plus P2 Computer setup and accepted ordinary native actions: Tychus dies before Region 24, P2-owned units remain absent, no P1-visible P2 ally appears, and no P2 command acknowledgement exists. The observed owner 16 units are Neutral.

A fresh pure-runtime thanson01/Iron session reached CreateGame=init_game and JoinGame=in_game, advanced from game loop 3 to 405 with requestStepsSent=0, and the map-owned Region 29 progression caused the runtime Galaxy bootstrap to observe 8 1gangtiegongchengche workers and 1 1gangtieyaosai fortress. No faction chat or debug API was used.

Fresh pure-runtime thanson01 sessions for Coverts, Umojan, Pirate, and Madness reached CreateGame=init_game and JoinGame=in_game, advanced in realtime with requestStepsSent=0, and observed their runtime replacement targets: SCVC plus CommandCenterC, SCVU plus CommandCenterU, 9shougezhe, and 3diguozhijian respectively. Each same-window ScriptError verdict has count=0 and no faction chat was required.

The owned thanson01 map still contains its original SCV creation statement; the launcher only declares replacements and injects runtime Galaxy lifecycle handlers and TriggerExecute bridges. Single-element runtime replacement rules are normalized before Galaxy generation, and the observed faction units are not statically authored into the map opening.

The commander-by-map rollout is represented as a complete 30-map x 5-commander matrix. Every cell has a preserved MapScript source, Stage 04 roster source, adapter rule, target Catalog IDs, protected players, and a dedicated evidence directory; seven cells currently have runtime evidence and 143 remain pending.

The thanson02 non-Iron pilot cells are not runtime-complete in this turn because the approved launcher did not obtain an independent ready API window while an external SC2 runtime was active; no existing process was terminated and no pass was inferred.
